docker_host.description: Local Docker Engine endpoint, default unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Possession is a host-admin capability shared by all same-identity IaC children (accepted v1 trust domain). Plaintext TCP is rejected. Never a Fleet input.

registry_auth.description: Optional private-registry credential for image pull. Schema-sensitive: write-only plaintext stored in the immutable SQLite Revision; never enters the Runner Execution Domain.
